description: This file implements the SensorEventConnection class within the Android sensor service, handling sensor event communication, data injection, event caching, and looper registration for sensor data delivery.

classes.name: SensorEventConnection
classes.description: Handles sensor event communication, including event sending, caching, and looper registration for a sensor service connection.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up the connection, marking it as destroyed and notifying the service.

methods.name: onFirstRef
methods.description: Called when the first reference to the connection is created.

methods.name: needsWakeLock
methods.description: Checks if a wake lock is needed based on the connection state.

methods.name: resetWakeLockRefCount
methods.description: Resets the wake lock reference count to zero.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs debugging information about the connection state.

methods.name: dump (protobuf version)
methods.description: Serializes connection info into a protobuf message for debugging.

methods.name: addSensor
methods.description: Adds a sensor handle to the connection if accessible.

methods.name: removeSensor
methods.description: Removes a sensor handle from the connection.

methods.name: getActiveSensorHandles
methods.description: Returns a list of active sensor handles.

methods.name: hasSensor
methods.description: Checks if a specific sensor handle is registered.

methods.name: hasAnySensor
methods.description: Checks if any sensors are registered.

methods.name: hasOneShotSensors
methods.description: Checks if any registered sensors are one-shot sensors.

methods.name: getPackageName
methods.description: Returns the package name associated with the connection.

methods.name: setFirstFlushPending
methods.description: Marks a sensor's flush as pending.

methods.name: updateLooperRegistration
methods.description: Updates the looper registration based on current sensors and mode.

methods.name: updateLooperRegistrationLocked
methods.description: Internal method to update looper registration with current connection state.

methods.name: incrementPendingFlushCountIfHasAccess
methods.description: Increments pending flush count if the connection has sensor access.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Sends sensor events to the connection, handling filtering, caching, and wake-up logic.

methods.name: hasSensorAccess
methods.description: Checks if the UID has access to sensors.

methods.name: noteOpIfRequired
methods.description: Notes app operation permission for a sensor event.

methods.name: reAllocateCacheLocked
methods.description: Resizes the event cache buffer.

methods.name: appendEventsToCacheLocked
methods.description: Appends new events to the cache, dropping oldest if necessary.

methods.name: sendPendingFlushEventsLocked
methods.description: Sends pending flush complete events.

methods.name: writeToSocketFromCache
methods.description: Writes cached events to the socket, handling partial writes and cache management.

methods.name: countFlushCompleteEventsLocked
methods.description: Counts flush complete events in a batch of events to be dropped.

methods.name: findWakeUpSensorEventLocked
methods.description: Finds a wake-up sensor event in a batch.

methods.name: getSensorChannel
methods.description: Returns the communication channel (BitTube) for the sensor.

methods.name: enableDisable
methods.description: Enables or disables a sensor handle with specified parameters.

methods.name: setEventRate
methods.description: Sets the event rate for a sensor handle.

methods.name: onMicSensorAccessChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in microphone sensor access, adjusting rates accordingly.

methods.name: capRates
methods.description: Caps sensor rates based on microphone toggle.

methods.name: uncapRates
methods.description: Restores sensor rates after being capped.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Requests flushing of sensor data.

methods.name: configureChannel
methods.description: Configures the sensor channel (not supported, returns invalid operation).

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events: errors, input data, and output readiness.

methods.name: computeMaxCacheSizeLocked
methods.description: Calculates maximum cache size based on sensor FIFO configurations.
